# locks/python-runtime.txt
# Pins Python packages in the final runner image. Installed via uv with
# --require-hashes. The locally-built vLLM and FlashInfer wheels are installed
# separately by exact file path (not from this lockfile).
#
# Generated by: scripts/bump.sh
# Seed inputs:
#   - vLLM requirements/common.txt + requirements/cuda.txt at VLLM_COMMIT
#   - RAY_VERSION, FASTSAFETENSORS_VERSION, INSTANTTENSOR_VERSION from versions.env
#   - NVSHMEM_VERSION, TVM_FFI_VERSION, TILELANG_VERSION, NUMBA_VERSION from versions.env
# Index URLs: PYPI_INDEX_URL + PYTORCH_INDEX_URL (cu130)
#
# DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY. Run scripts/bump.sh on the DGX Spark to regenerate.
# This file must be generated on Linux aarch64 to produce correct wheel hashes.
